name: Circle USYC
oneLiner: Circle USYC is Hashnote's tokenized T-bill fund share backed by short-term U.S. Treasuries and reverse repos, redeemable at NAV.
collateral: Short-term U.S. Treasury bills and reverse repo agreements held for Circle USYC / Hashnote fund shares in segregated brokerage and custody accounts.
pegMechanism: Same-day subscription and redemption via USDC at NAV-based token price

applicabilityBasis.summary: USYC represents shares of the Hashnote International Short Duration Fund Ltd., a Cayman Islands mutual fund investing in short-term U.S. Treasuries and reverse repos, administered by Circle International Bermuda Limited. The GENIUS Act defines payment stablecoins as fixed-value instruments redeemable at a predetermined fixed amount; USYC accrues yield through NAV appreciation and is therefore not a payment stablecoin. The SEC/CFTC March 2026 Joint Interpretive Release (Release Nos. 33-11412 and 34-105020) classifies tokenized fund shares in the digital-securities bucket, consistent with existing Howey analysis. Shares are restricted to non-U.S. persons under Regulation S.

references.label: Astraea Counsel — Tokenized Treasury Funds: Securities Compliance 2026

genius.issuerEntity: Circle International Bermuda Limited (token administrator, BMA-licensed); Hashnote International Short Duration Fund Ltd. (Cayman Islands mutual fund)
genius.notes: USYC is a tokenized fund share in the Hashnote International Short Duration Fund Ltd. (Cayman Islands registered mutual fund), not a payment stablecoin. The GENIUS Act payment-stablecoin framework does not apply: USYC is yield-bearing via NAV appreciation, not fixed-value, and represents a securities interest. Circle acquired Hashnote in January 2025; the token administrator is Circle International Bermuda Limited, regulated by the Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA) under its DABA License.
